page.layout: One column of running text, dictionary entries in Latin and Hebrew, with the printed page number at top left and a Hebrew running head centred at top. No margin notes, no footnotes.

main_text.p: בַּד Linum, Lineum, Exod.28.42. Plur. בַּדִים Linea, Ezech.9.2. Item Vectes, Exod.27.6. Rami, Ezech. 17.6. & 19.14. Membra, Job.41.3. Constr. בְּדֵי Vectes, Exod.27.6. Aff. בַּדָּיו Vectes ejus; id est, Artus, vel offa ejus, quae ceu Vectes corpori inhaerent, Job.18.13. Alias significationes vide in duabus seqq. Radicibus.
בָּרָא Effinxit; Mentitus, Commentus fuit, 1.Reg.12.38. Partic. cum Aff. בְּרָאָם Effingi ea, Nehem.6.8. pro בְּרָאָם.

בְּרִים m.p. Mendacia, Mendaces, Jes.44.25. per quos illic intelligυntur חוֹזֵי בַכּוֹכָבִים Inspicientes astra, Astrologi, juxta R.Sal. & sic intelligas Jer.50.36. R.David ibi: וְקָרְאָם בְּדִים לְפִי שֶׁהֵם כּוֹזְבִים בְּמִשְׁפַּט הַמּוּלוֹת לְעַמִּים Aff. בְּרֶיךָ Mendacia tua, Job.11.3. בְּרָיו Mendacia ejus, Jesa.16.6. & sic Jer.48.30. א elisio.
בָּדַד Solitarius fuit, Solitarium egit: Particip. בּוֹדֵד Solitarius existens, Jesaj.14.31. לוֹ בּוֹדֵד Solitarius sibi; Hos.8.9.

בָּדָד m. Solus, sed sumitur semper adverbialiter, Seorsum, Solitarie, unde masculinis & foemininis jungitur, tam per se quam cum ל ab initio: ut, יֵשֵׁב בָּדָד Desidet solitarie, id est, Solitarius, Thren.3.28. Et foem. יֵשְׁבָה בָּדָד Desidet solitarie, hoc est, solitaria, Thren.1.1. Et numero plur. בָּדָד יִשְׁכְּנוּ Solitarie habitabunt, Jer.49.31. Et cum prosthesi, לְבָדָד Solitarie, Mich.7.14.
בַּד Solus; בַּד בְּבַד יִהְיֶה Solus cum solo esto, Exod.30.34. id est, Unumquodque, solum vel seorsum esto, ut Ab.Esra explicat. Cum prosthesi ל adverbiascit:

לְבַד Seorsum, Zach.12.12. Sequente Praepositione מִן, est Praeter; לְבַד מִן הַשַּׁהֲרֹנִים Prater lunulas, Judic.8.26. לְבַד מִשָּׂרֵי Prater principes, 1.Reg.5.16. Vel ei praefixâ: ut מִלְּבַד נָשִׁי Prater uxores, Gen.4.6.26. Cum Aff. est, Solus לְבַדִּי

page.notes: Large Hebrew lead words of the entries are set in a bigger type and are copied as the Hebrew letters they show; vowel points are only partly legible and are given approximately. Doubtful: the Hebrew forms in the third entry (בְּרֶיךָ, the Hebrew sentence after R.David ibi, and the elision mark "א elisio"), the Hebrew forms after "Effingi", and "intelligυntur" with a v printed in u-form, which is copied as printed. The Hebrew in the second and third entry is uncertain and may contain errors in pointing.
